title: Streaming pass
topic: Twelve 30-day trials started the same day all expire together
blurb: A friend thinks signing up twelve times has banked a year of free video.
prompt: A friend just texted this in the group chat. If one line doesn't add up, tap it.

segments.label: The offer
segments.text: The streaming app gives a 30-day free trial that stays on even if you cancel right away.

segments.label: The move
segments.text: I just signed up with 12 different emails today and cancelled all of them immediately.

segments.label: The stash
segments.text: That queues up a full year of free streaming without paying a cent.

segments.label: The vibe
segments.text: If anyone else wants in, I can send the signup steps.

conclusion: Twelve 30-day trials, started today, add up to a year of free watching.

flaws.original: All 12 trials started today, so they run at the same time and all end in 30 days — not one after another.
flaws.corrupted: That queues up a full year of free streaming without paying a cent.

diagnosis_choices.label: The 12 trials all started today, so they expire on the same day — you get 30 days, not a year.
Cancelling immediately ends a trial on the spot, so none of the 12 will actually run.
12 × 30 is only 360 days, so it's a few days short of a full year.
You can only watch on one email at a time, so the extra accounts do nothing.

fix_choices.label: Admit it's 30 days of overlapping trials, not a year lined up back to back.
Start the next email only after each 30 days ends, if you want them in a line.
Sign up for 13 trials to cover the extra days and make it a real year.
Keep all 12 logged in at once so the year gets used up faster.

flaws.explanation: All 12 of your trials will expire on the exact same Tuesday.
flaws.why_tempting: 12 × 30 feels like stocking inventory. It's easy to forget that calendar time for each account starts now, not when the last one finishes.
flaws.catch_rule: If you start several free trials on the same day, they run in parallel — they don't get in line.
flaws.hint: When does trial number 12 actually start — next year, or today?

practice.problem: A friend books four 7-day gym guest passes today, one on each of four guest emails, and says that's four weeks of free workouts. What's wrong?
practice.answer: All four passes start today, so they overlap. That's one week, not four.

clean_segments: The streaming app gives a 30-day free trial that stays on even if you cancel right away.
I just signed up with 12 different emails today and cancelled all of them immediately.
All 12 trials started today, so they run at the same time and all end in 30 days — not one after another.
If anyone else wants in, I can send the signup steps.
clean_conclusion: Twelve trials started today all end in 30 days. That's not a year.
